issuing_authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the PRC
title_original: 在中国境内就业的外国人参加社会保险暂行办法
title_english: Interim Measures for the Participation in Social Insurance by Foreigners Employed in China (MoHRSS Order No. 16)
legal_reference_number: MoHRSS Order No. 16 (人力资源和社会保障部令第16号)
summary: Mandates that foreigners legally employed within the territory of China must participate in the five statutory social insurances: Basic Pension, Basic Medical Insurance, Work-related Injury Insurance, Unemployment Insurance, and Maternity Insurance.
key_provisions: Article 3: Employers recruiting foreigners shall complete social insurance registration within 30 days of obtaining employment certificates.
Article 4: Both employer and foreign employee shall make monthly social insurance contributions pursuant to statutory rates.
Article 9: Social insurance agreements between China and foreign countries shall govern exemption from specific contributions (bilateral treaty reciprocity).
applicable_population: Legally employed foreign nationals holding Work Permit in China

issuing_authority: Ministry of Education, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Public Security
title_original: 学校招收和培养国际学生管理办法
title_english: Provisions on the Administration of the Enrollment and Cultivation of International Students by Schools (Joint Order No. 42)
legal_reference_number: MoE, MFA, MPS Joint Order No. 42 (教育部、外交部、公安部令第42号)
summary: Requires that all international students studying at schools in China must purchase comprehensive medical insurance covering accidental injury and inpatient hospitalization.
key_provisions: Article 41: Schools shall implement an international student insurance system. International students must purchase comprehensive medical insurance in accordance with national regulations.
Article 41: Schools shall not register or enroll international students who fail to purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance.

title_english: Shenzhen Medical Security Measures (Shenzhen Municipal Gov Order No. 358)
legal_reference_number: Shenzhen Municipal Order No. 358 (深圳市人民政府令第358号)
summary: Establishes Shenzhen municipal basic medical insurance into First-tier (Tier 1, comprehensive individual account and pool fund) and Second-tier (Tier 2, municipal pool fund for inpatient and outpatient capitation).
key_provisions: Employees with employment relations in Shenzhen participate in Tier 1 or Tier 2 based on employer registration.
Tier 1 participants may use personal medical accounts for outpatient pharmacy and family member health expenses.
Community Health Centers (社康中心) provide primary outpatient consultations with preferential 75% to 90% reimbursement.
applicable_population: Foreign employees participating in Shenzhen social insurance

issuing_authority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
title_original: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
title_english: Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC (PIPL)
legal_reference_number: Presidential Order No. 91 (中华人民共和国主席令第九十一号)
summary: China's foundational personal information protection statute, classifying medical and financial insurance data as Sensitive Personal Information requiring separate consent and security impact assessments.
key_provisions: Article 28: Biometric, medical health, financial accounts, and personal tracking are Sensitive Personal Information.
Article 29: Processing sensitive personal information requires specific necessity and separate consent from the individual.
Article 39: Cross-border transfer of personal information requires statutory compliance mechanisms (CAC security assessment, certification, or standard contract).
applicable_population: Entities processing personal information in China
Insurance platforms handling health and claim data
